description: Every manual change applied on top of the automated pipeline. Each entry records the target, the original value, the corrected value, the kind of correction, the evidence, a confidence level, the reason and the date. The world builder refuses entries that lack any of these fields.

overrides.reason: University Library has no building:levels/height in OSM. Floor count above the forecourt estimated from the photograph published with the official campus map entry (H3).
New Asia water tower: no height in OSM. Estimated from the official landmark photograph by comparison with adjacent trees and cars; not a surveyed value.
United College water tower: no height in OSM. Estimated from the official landmark photograph; not a surveyed value.
Sir Run Run Shaw Hall: auditorium volume with no levels tag in OSM. Height estimated from the official campus map photograph.
Institute of Chinese Studies: low courtyard building with no levels tag in OSM. Two storeys estimated from the official campus map photograph.

overrides.corrected: Four pillars and a name wall generated at the official landmark point (22.418046, 114.203208), aligned to the nearest OSM road centre-line.
overrides.reason: The University Main Entrance pillars are not mapped as geometry in OSM. Position comes from the official map point; the arrangement is an interpretation of the official photograph, not a survey.
